deviations: The hand-off set is derived, not listed. The test reads the TV dispatchers (app/tv/page.tsx ScreenFor and the landing, MathsTV, EssayTV, and Linga through lingaOwns). It strips comments with TypeScript's own parser and printer, then marks a screen as a hand-off when its component, or a top-level helper that component reaches, asks for a phone action. The scan found 22 screens: landing, pair, joined, tonight, page, lesson, essaytype, forensic, profile, practice, sheet, walk, and the 10 linga screens. The linga screens count as one hand-off, which gives N=12 with a panel plus lesson. Lesson says 'circle on the phone' but no phone panel does that, so it maps to 'stay' and the test names the gap. Sentence is not a hand-off on the current tree. Its 'say or type another sentence on the phone' is a key-press status in keys.ts, not the screen's copy, so it maps to 'stay'. Forensic is a new hand-off to paste (from 'Rewrite on my phone'), which the prior attempt did not have. The follow key also changes when Tonight starts waiting for a page (awaiting set) while the screen id stays 'tonight'. I did not reuse tools/kpi-measure.cjs stripComments because it exists only in a sibling's uncommitted work.
notes: Changes a user will notice on the phone: (1) When the TV enters a hand-off, the phone switches panels by itself. Profile goes to the Profile tab. 'I have homework' (Tonight waiting for a page) and a page whose read failed go to Capture, which turns on the camera. Practice, sheet and walk go to Practice. Essay lens and forensic go to Essay (paste). This happens once per change of screen. It never happens while the learner is typing, holds an unsent shot, is recording or pressed Mic, or while Linga is listening. It never happens in the Parent role. (2) Linga no longer pulls the phone back to the Linga panel on every Linga screen change. It pulls once, when Linga starts. (3) A phone joining mid-session goes straight to the panel for the TV's current hand-off (e.g. Essay, Linga, Profile), except a camera panel: then it lands on the joined confirmation, as before. (4) An unjoined phone still goes to Join. It moves to Profile when the TV opens Profile. page.tsx now imports @/tv/keys (lingaOwns) through panelFor.ts. Not browser-verified: no Playwright or TV pass was run.
